Inland Revenue Department Sri Lanka: Value Added Tax — standard rate 8% to 31 May 2022, 12% from 1 June 2022, 15% from 1 September 2022 and 18% from 1 January 2024; financial services 18% from 1 January 2022

caveats: The tax year is the calendar year from 2024 (grade I); the 2023/24 year was the transitional nine months from 1 April to 31 December 2023, which the schema cannot express as a start-month/day pair.
companyYearEndDefault is a 31 December app default for new entities (grade I), not a statutory requirement; companies may choose other year ends under national law.

Sri Lanka raised VAT three times during the window (June 2022, September 2022, January 2024) under IMF-programme revenue measures; the 8% row is a lower bound from the start of the window (the 8% rate dated from December 2019).
